title: RHC Character Rests (POST-EV2-10)
description: Bounded operational per-character Rest lifecycle record for one tracked character:<slug>. One character owns exactly one Rest lifecycle record; a shared camp scene contains several independent records, never one shared mechanical Rest record. The record carries only the Rest lifecycle state and its authoritative elapsed-time anchors/interruption state (never HP, Hit Dice, spell slots or feature charges, which POST-EV2-9 owns). Progress is derived from RT02 elapsed campaign minutes plus this bounded state; no minute-by-minute ticks are persisted. Long-Rest implementation/eligibility anchors are engine-derived from authoritative published elapsed time, never caller-invented wall-clock time.

status.description: idle = no current attempt; active = an in-progress Short or Long Rest; completed = the attempt finished with benefits applied; interrupted = a Short Rest broken with no benefits (a Long Rest instead resumes and stays active).

rest_kind.description: The kind of the current/last attempt; null only while idle.

started_at_elapsed_minutes.description: Engine-derived absolute elapsed anchor stamped from authoritative published RT02 elapsed_campaign_minutes; null while idle.

required_minutes.description: Official minimum whole-minute requirement. Short Rest = 60; Long Rest = 480 plus 60 per recorded interruption. Null while idle.

completed_at_elapsed_minutes.description: Engine-derived absolute completion anchor; null unless status is completed.

last_long_rest_completed_at_elapsed_minu.description: Personal last-successful-Long-Rest completion anchor, preserved across later attempts so the official 16-hour next-start rule is deterministic. Null when the character has never completed a Long Rest in tracked time.

interruptions.description: Bounded ordered interruptions of the current/long attempt. Each records the rules cause and the engine-derived elapsed anchor. A Short Rest holds none (an interruption ends it as `interrupted`).

short_benefit_granted.description: True once Short Rest benefits have been granted to the active Long Rest after a rules-valid interruption at least 1 hour in. Prevents duplicate recovery.
